deadline.value: Priority applications for fall admission are due January 15, 2027, with a final deadline of May 15, 2027.
deadline.quote: Deadlines to apply for fall admission: January 15th (priority), May 15th (final)

gre_general.value: The GRE General is optional for BME and is highly recommended for applicants with weaker GPA or research experience, or with international transcripts.
gre_general.quote: (Optional) Official Graduate Record Examinations (GRE) General Test scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The statement must name at least one BME faculty member as a prospective advisor, and applicants are encouraged to contact faculty.
supervisor.quote: This statement should clearly state the study track(s) of interest and at least one Ph.D. faculty member as a prospective advisor.

also.quote: Applicants are encouraged to contact BME faculty members who are doing work in areas that align with their own research interests

funding.value: A graduate assistantship covers tuition with a stipend, but BME says offers of financial support are competitive.
funding.quote: Please be aware that offers of financial support are competitive.

entry_route.value: Applicants need at least a Bachelor of Science from an accredited institution; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: Prior to commencing graduate study, applicants must hold a minimum of a Bachelor of Science degree from an accredited institution.

notes: The BME program is a PhD only. It has four tracks: biomaterials, biomechanics, human performance and mechanobiology. Spring deadlines are August 15 (priority) and October 15 (final).
name: Biomedical Engineering PhD
